tools.name: generate_mural_mockups
tools.title: Generate mural mockups
tools.description: Render 3 photorealistic mural mockups (frontal shipping container, angled brick corner, obstructed concrete facade) from an artwork image URL. Optionally composite the mural onto a provided wall photo.

artworkUrl.description: Public HTTPS URL of the artwork image to paint as a mural.

wallUrl.description: Optional public HTTPS URL of a wall photo to use as the background plate.

variant.description: 'base' for default composition, 'retry' to recompose lighting/angle.

count.description: Number of mockup scenes to render (1-3).
